I'm not a coder, so ELI5 please, is a bot revealed without the owner doing so? How do we sniff these baddies out?

Bots can be sniffed out by looking through upvote/downvote logs, post and comment logs to determine if there is a pattern, or to see if it is doing something humanly impossible (i.e. upvoting 10 things at the same time).

Many bots do reveal the fact that they're bots, and the ones that do are usually not bad. People create bots that reply to comments with information that's relevant to the topic. For example, reddit has a bot called AutoWikiBot that replies to Wikipedia links with a short snippet from the page, to save people the time it takes to open the page. A bot is just a program that performs tasks automatically, and they can be good or bad.
